objects.description: [Kali365](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9044)'s desktop client has made Microsoft Graph API calls using the distinct User-Agent string `kali365-live/1.0.0` to access victim mailboxes and enumerate account data following OAuth token capture.(Citation: Artic Wolf Labs Kali365 Device Code April 2026)
